meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: 把你当前对话里已经聊过、已经掌握的内容直接综合成一份 spec(PRD),不发问、不做访谈,写完发布到项目 issue tracker 并打上 ready-for-agent 标签。
howto.when: 当你已经和 Claude 讨论完某个功能、想把现有结论写成 spec 时,手动调用本技能;它不会主动接管对话(已关闭模型自动调用)。

say.text: 把我们刚才讨论的内容整理成 spec,发布到 issue tracker
say.note: 不提问,只综合已有对话。

say.text: 按代码库现有术语写 spec,并说明你打算在哪一层做测试
say.note: 会先探查仓库并和你确认测试接缝。

say.text: 写 spec 时把本次范围之外的东西单独列出来
say.note: 对应模板里的 Out of Scope。

howto.what_en: Turns the current conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (PRD) — no interview, just synthesis — then publishes it to the project issue tracker with the ready-for-agent label.
howto.when_en: Use it manually once you have already discussed a feature and want the conclusions written up as a spec. It does not take over on its own (model invocation is disabled).

say_en.text: Turn what we just discussed into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker
say_en.note: No interview — it only synthesizes the conversation.

say_en.text: Write the spec in the repo's glossary terms and say where you'd test
say_en.note: It explores the repo and confirms test seams first.

say_en.text: Keep anything outside this feature out of scope in the spec
say_en.note: That fills the Out of Scope section.
